text:
alex: Heads-up — we want to deprecate the legacy `x-route-hint` header in favor of `x-route-policy`. This will unify policy semantics across console and SDKs.
sarah: +1 on the consolidation, but this is gonna touch Python/TS SDK surface. Do we have a compat shim plan?
tyler: We discussed a shim in infra but didn't finalize rollout. Options: 1) SDKs auto-map `x-route-hint` -> `x-route-policy` for 3 months, logging a deprecation warning. 2) Runtime accepts both but console only emits new one.
mike: Concern: quota attribution in console is keyed off the header value today. If we auto-map, console dashboards will show mixed keys and break billing charts.
alex: Right — we need a deterministic canonicalization step before ingestion. Proposal: router normalizes header to canonical policy id before emitting to metering + console. That keeps dashboards stable.
sarah: Can we do normalization in the gateway layer? That avoids SDK churn. But SDKs should still add warnings to nudge customers.
tyler: Gateway normalization is ideal, but not all customers go through our hosted gateway (dedicated/private). For Private, SDKs might be the only place to catch old headers.
devex-liz: From SDK-UX POV, lightweight warnings are fine, but please don't break code paths. A semantic change to header encoding will break integrations.
mike: Also telemetry — sampling and tag extraction logic will need update. Current sampler extracts route hash by splitting on `:`; new policy format uses JSON-ish kv. Sampler needs to be robust.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 03/29 02:00 UTC (gateway-normalizer v2).
alex: Draft rollout plan: A) Gateway normalizer deployed to hosted first (canary), B) add shim in SDKs (py/ts/go) to map legacy -> new with DeprecationWarning for 90 days, C) update console ingestion to canonicalize keys and backfill last 30d for graphs, D) add telemetry tests + e2e.
tyler: For SDK implementation, recommended pattern: keep header setter backwards-compatible, add opt-in flag to enable strict mode. Example for Python: 
```python
# existing
client.set_route_hint("team:search-v2")
# new shim
client.set_route_policy("{\"policy\":\"search-v2\", \"weight\":10}", lax=True)  # maps old formats
```
sarah: TS/Go folks: implement same lax/default behavior. Then ship a minor bump, not major. Document breaking caveat that strict mode will validate and throw.
mike: Console team: can we get an API spec for canonical policy id by EOD? We need it to align metering keys.
alex: Yes — I'll post the canonicalization rules in a follow-up. Quick rules: (1) prefer stable policy id string (no whitespace), (2) strip ephemeral instance suffixes, (3) map legacy aliases via table.
devex-liz: Docs + migration guide — we'll prepare a short how-to: "How to migrate from x-route-hint to x-route-policy" with code snippets and a CLI check tool.
tyler: Testing matrix: hosted path, dedicated (gateway with normalizer disabled), private (no gateway). For private, SDK shim must be enabled by default for 90 days and opt-out via env var.
alex: Good call. Env var name: REDWOOD_ROUTE_COMPAT=legacy|lax|strict (default=lax).
mike: Telemetry team: also consider sampling implications — moving from header to structured payload could change sampling distribution. We need to run a sampling join on historical logs.
sarah: Agree. Also need to update console's per-route latency + cost tiles mapping. If canonical IDs change, past tiles need remapping. Backfill plan?
alex: Backfill: run map job that rewrites keys in metrics store for last 30d. We will not rewrite raw logs. Console will present remapped time series.
tyler: SDK release plan: py/ts/go minor with deprecation warnings -> ship in two weeks if we freeze PRs today. Notify integrators via changelog and web banner.
devex-liz: I'll prepare changelog blurb and a short migration checklist. Also recommend adding a `redwood-cli route-check` that flags old header usage across repos.
alex: One more callout — function calling and tool routing uses route policy to select model variants. Ensure that runtime fallback still works if only old header present.
mike: Runtime will accept both for 3 months and prefer canonical policy. Need testcases for fallback metrics.
ops-bot: alert: nightly smoke for console mapping failed 2 tests in canary.
sarah: Investigating now — looks like two policy aliases weren't in the mapping table.
alex: Fix mapping table and redeploy canary. Also run a quick smoke between gateway->console ingestion path.
tyler: I'll add unit tests in SDKs for parsing both old and new formats.
devex-liz: ETA on docs + CLI: 48 hours.
alex: Thanks team — action items: alex to publish canonical rules, tyler to submit SDK PRs with env var, sarah to patch mapping table, mike to coordinate backfill, devex-liz to publish docs. We'll reconvene in #eng-platform tomorrow AM for rollout signoff. :thumbsup:
